identity.server_message: server_id assigned on accepted; stable UI key remains client_message_id

event.ordering: positive contiguous seq per request; retain watermark across resubscription; pending gap bound 32; next contiguous event may enter full buffer to drain it

kinds.accepted: value: server message identity; distinct from transport ACK and generation completion
kinds.error: value: error reason, retains partial content

invariants: selected page never routes transport events
account and conversation are always checked together
epoch and full request identity must match before state mutation
terminal state rejects later stream mutations
same local begin identity is idempotent; conflicting reuse fails
history uses server identity and revision; active row cannot be overwritten by snapshot
reasoning/DIL/attachments do not append to body text
draft/scroll intent belongs to conversation, not global screen
history: prefix reserved; exact accepted server_id may reconcile only a history-owned row; stream-authoritative active content remains
another local send with same server_id is a collision, never merged by text
conversation.resync: conflicting buffered sequence or gap budget -> explicit error; obtaining authoritative snapshot and resetting generation is outside executable model

request.capability_gate: capabilities supplied by fixture; no inference from UI controls

response.correlation: entire RPC identity must match pending entry
response.wire_mapping: Internal normalized adapter event, not required server echo fields. Obtain host/epoch/stream from authenticated connection and operation/thread from pending registry by response id. Never infer from current selected host.

invariants: host switch updates selection only
each host maintains distinct pending table
same request number in distinct hosts is permitted
results retained per request, never keyed only by method
reconnect invalidates only replaced host generation and settles prior pending
permission errors remain errors, not empty successful result
bound account-host membership is fixture precondition, not authentication implementation
local request cancellation is not remote turn interruption
timeouts and disconnect failures are local to affected request/host
explicit error is error even if empty; only absent/null error means success

compatibility: Reference v1 is deliberately separate from observed official schemas. Adapters must preserve original field names and cite mappings. No production API is changed.
